title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of light tiles seen from above at an angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a green disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows an orange arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show steps to goal and moves made.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the green goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes either the row or the column by one. You need 2 moves right and 2 moves up, in any order: 4 moves at best.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
A move that would leave the board does nothing and is not counted. The hint arrow points right if the goal is to the right, otherwise up; it hides after your next move.
